Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring agency reports to the legislature to be submitted electronically.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to filing reports electronically to thelegislature; and adding a new section to chapter 43.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Reports from state agencies to the legislature shall be provided inan electronic format to the chief clerk of the house of representativesand the secretary of the senate. The chief clerk of the house ofrepresentatives and the secretary of the senate shall provide an onlinesite for reports submitted to the legislature on the legislativeinternet home page. The reports shall be organized in such a way as tomake the reports easy to find and accessible by legislators, staff, andthe public. Upon submitting required reports to the legislature electronically,the agency shall send a letter to the appropriate legislative committeethat the report has been filed electronically with the chief clerk ofthe house of representatives and the secretary of the senate to be madeavailable on the legislative internet home page. The letter may also p. 1 HB 2129include a brief summary of the report. The agency may make hard copiesavailable by request.
